description: This file is a PHP source file defining a controller class 'Banner' within the Opencart admin design namespace. It handles CRUD operations, listing, form handling, and status updates for banner entities in the Opencart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class managing banner operations in the Opencart admin module, including listing, form handling, saving, and status updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the banner list view, setting up breadcrumbs and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Responds with the banner list, mainly a wrapper around getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of banners based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a banner, populating data with existing banner info if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a banner (create or update) via POST data, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected banners by updating their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected banners by updating their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected banners from the system.
